messages:
deploy-bot: ALERT: canary v4.9.0 increase in p95 (+33%) on route 'summarize-eu' detected. Autorevert scheduled in 5m unless overridden. metrics: https://telemetry/redwood/v4.9.0?span=5m
ana: Noted. This landed right at the start of the change window. Does the spike look regional or global?
peter: I pulled the slices 56; it's concentrated to eu-west nodes with the new runtime scheduling tweak. Errors are low, just latency. Prefer a targeted route pin to avoid blocking the whole rollout.
jamal: Oncall. I agree with targeted pin. We should suppress autorevert for a short window to verify traces, then pin route if shard-local. Who can run route-pin?
ivy: I can. Proposed plan: 1) suppress autorevert for 20m 2) route-pin summarize-eu in canary to v4.8.8 3) drain v4.9.0 pods on affected AZs 4) send CS blurb and open postmortem ticket RL-8200.
nana: Small nit: also check KV cache hit rates and batching distribution; the runtime tweak changed prefetch timing.
ops-bot: Autorevert countdown: 300s. Operator override required to suppress timer.
jamal: Taking operator. Suppress autorevert for 20m while we triage.
ops-bot: Operator override accepted. Autorevert suppression set for 20m.
ivy: Running: ```bash
rls route-pin --env canary --route summarize-eu --to v4.8.8 --reason "p95 regression on EU slices"
```
ops-bot: Executing command... SUCCESS: route summarize-eu pinned to v4.8.8. Traffic rebalanced.
peter: Metrics: p95 back to baseline on pinned slices. KVCACHE miss rate spiked concurrently with the runtime tweak. Looks correlated.
nana: Good. Ivy, can you draft a short CS note? Keep it minimal: "We observed increased response times for a small subset of EU traffic after a canary update and routed that traffic to the previous version while we investigate. No customer data exposed; updates in 30 minutes."
ivy: Draft sent to #customer-notify and cc @cs-team.
jamal: Opening RL-8200 and attaching traces. Decision criteria recorded: metric delta >25% p95, scope <40% of region, error-rate <1% -> targeted pin preferred.
ops-bot: Reminder: suppression will expire at +20m. Extend if needed via operator request.
nana: Follow-up: keep pin for 30m, collect traces, and prepare a revert candidate if we find a quick fix. If other regions show similar drift, we'll escalate to full revert.
ivy: Manual intervention done: suppressed autorevert, applied targeted route pin, CS notified, postmortem ticket created. Thanks all :thumbsup:
